reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, I don't need it to go. I hate swallowing pills and I buy gummies or drinks, and 2 capsules a day is exactly what I'd skip.
objection: Two capsules every night, and I forget my vitamins half the time anyway. A box of 30 would sit on the counter half full.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink version at about the same price.
